answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus heartbeat checks stop bulk fakes. A new identity posts 40 POA to bridge into the market; each epoch the beacon audits 10% of identities, each answering a fresh cipher challenge proving live compute in an hour. A missed check burns 20 POA, a second burns the rest and removes the identity. 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA and draw 100 audits per epoch, bleeding 2,000 POA per epoch — a voyage that only gets costlier. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted.
